m: ऋध् cl. 6. 2. 4. 5. 7.P. (Pot. 1. pl. ऋधेम, AV.; Subj. 3. sg. ऋधत्, RV.; pres. p. ऋधत्; cf. ऋधद् below) ऋध्यति; ऋध्नोति; ऋणद्धि; आनर्ध, अर्धिता, अर्धिष्यति, &c., to grow, increase, prosper, succeed, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; MBh.; Mn. &c.; to cause to increase or prosper, promote, make prosperous, accomplish, RV.; AV.; VS.; ŚBr. : Pass. ऋध्यते, to be promoted, increase, prosper, succeed, ŚBr.; BṛĀrUp. : Caus. अर्धयति, to satisfy, AV. vii, 80, 4; Nir. : Desid. अर्दिधिषति or ईर्त्सति; [cf. √ राध् and वृध्.]
a: ऋध् — {c4c} {c5c} P. (ऋध्यति, ऋध्नोति, आनर्ध, आर्धीत्, अर्धितुं, ऋद्ध); sometimes {c7c} P. (ऋणद्धि) 1 To prosper, flourish, thrive, succeed; नाब्रह्म क्षत्रमृध्नोति Ms. 9. 322. --2 To grow, increase (fig. also). --3 To cause to succeed, make prosperous. --4 To satisfy, gratify, please, propitiate; Māl. 5. 29. --5 To accomplish. --Desid. ईर्त्सति or अर्दिधिषति.

m: ऋधङ्—मन्त्र mfn. one who is destitute of speech [BRD.], AV. v, 1, 7.
ऋधद् (by Sandhi for ऋधत् pres. p. of ऋध् cl. 6).
ऋधद्—री (√ री) mfn. one whose speed is increasing or excessive, exceedingly swift (as horses), RV. viii, 46, 23.
ऋधद्—वार mfn. one whose wealth is increasing or abundant, abounding in wealth (said of Agni), RV. vi, 3, 2.
